document.abstract: The purpose of this amendment is to change the Timing Jitter specification for the interface to correctly reflect the requirements and capabilities of 12G-SDI equipment. It also corrects arithmetic errors in the alignment jitter specification where the time representation of 0.3UI is inaccurately calculated in the standard.
